reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), AI basket drawdown / momentum, Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.73% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +2bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.3pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 12bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 143 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 90 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 16.0 sits at the 26th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 13.2, so implied carries +2.9 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nebius sinks 13% after $4.5B convertible note offering paired with exchange of existing 2029/2031 notes
items.note: Nebius raised $2.75B (2030) + $1.75B (2034) converts and is exchanging older notes for shares, with management warning exchange holders may dump shares/unwind hedges; concrete evidence a neocloud with $8B cash still can't self-fund $5.66B/quarter capex without repeated dilutive refinancing.

items.headline: WSJ tally of $3 trillion in off-balance-sheet AI commitments triggers neocloud selloff
items.note: First concrete sizing of hyperscaler off-balance-sheet lease/SPV commitments (~$3T across nine firms) drove CoreWeave -6.8%, Nebius -5.2%, TeraWulf -6.5%, directly evidencing the circular-financing/SPV risk this thesis tracks rather than an equity-only move on sentiment alone.

items.headline: BofA fund manager survey: 38% now call hyperscaler AI capex the top systemic credit-event risk
items.note: Second straight month hyperscaler capex tops the systemic-risk list (ahead of private credit at 23%), yet 71% still expect no 2026 capex cut — a sentiment/positioning signal, not a realized event, worth tracking for a turn.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
